# AI Chauffeur

> One call or a thousand. Every one answered. Every one booked.

AI Chauffeur answers your limo phone. Books the trip. Puts it in your CRM. Never a busy signal, never voicemail.

Last reviewed: 2026-09-28

## What it does

- It takes the whole trip like your best dispatcher — flight number, meet and greet, passengers, bags, child seats, gate codes.
- Picks the right car for the group. If there are more people than the car holds, it moves the trip up to a bigger car.
- Trip sheet on your phone. Text to you, text to the customer, the recording and every word of the call attached.
- Every call recorded. The recording and every word of the call come back with the trip sheet.
- Your people run the cars. AI Chauffeur runs the phones.
- [What it does](https://aichauffeur.ai/what-it-does/): Every part of a call, from the answer to the trip sheet
- [What it can do for your company](https://aichauffeur.ai/what-it-can-do/): Every company runs its phones a little differently. These are set up for your company when we build your desk.

## Live demo

- [Try AI Chauffeur](https://aichauffeur.ai/try/): Not a phone call — it talks to you in your browser. About two minutes.
- This is a demo. Act like a customer calling a limo company and answer its questions.
- Demo only. No car is dispatched.
- Try AI Chauffeur and talk to it in your browser, or call (414) 775-0019 and AI Chauffeur picks up. It is the same agent your callers would reach, with no form and no salesperson.

## Book the setup call

- [Book the setup call](https://aichauffeur.ai/book/): Schedules the 20-minute setup call.
- Every build is custom to your operation — your rates, your service area, your vehicle classes. We scope it on the setup call.
- The setup call is a conversation, not a pitch.
- Setup is done for you by our team. Typical timeline is one to two weeks once your rate rules, service area, and dispatch process are documented.
- [How setup works](https://aichauffeur.ai/how-setup-works/): How setup works, step by step, is written out in full.

## Works with your software

- [Works with your software](https://aichauffeur.ai/works-with-your-software/): No switch, no rip-out — here is exactly how it sits beside the dispatch software you already run.
- [Integrations](https://aichauffeur.ai/integrations/): Where each platform stands, in one table — the integration status of all ten.
- Direct write-back into a dispatch system is configured per account and switched on after setup verification.
- [Limo Anywhere](https://aichauffeur.ai/integrations/limo-anywhere/): AI Chauffeur works beside Limo Anywhere. Direct write-back is configured and verified against your own account before it is switched on.
- [FASTTRAK](https://aichauffeur.ai/integrations/fasttrak/): AI Chauffeur works beside FASTTRAK. A partner API integration is scoped during setup and built around your account, not bolted on afterwards.

## FAQ

- Does it replace my dispatcher? No. It takes the phones so your dispatcher is not buried by missed calls and repeated questions.
- What still requires dispatcher approval? Assigning the car and the driver.
- AI Chauffeur is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.
